comments.body: I'd also point out any cases where he appears to be internally inconsistent with his terminology, either in using a give term for a different concept or in applying synonyms to a single concept. In the translation, as much as possible, I'd like to avoid synonyms that are used merely for stylistic variety.

using Arabic vs Roman or serif vs non would be visible, but I'm not sure if readers could keep in mind which is which. Footnotes vs endnotes would be another possibility, but probably not good. Probably just (Ed) or something would work. How did Peter and I do it in the Jespersen text?
